operation_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase preserves the objects, uncertain starting state, collection and trace attribution, transition checks, independence checks, supported chronology, separation from narrative order, gaps and competing sequences.

limit_preserved.rationale: All material limitations remain: evidence defects, ambiguous identities and material interpretations, recopying or restoration, missing or misidentified transitions, local scope, unassumed availability and the association assumption under test. no_verdict_language.rationale: The paraphrase describes behavior and evidential scope without judging ordinariness, novelty, creativity, departure or the addition or absence of a new warrant. Its consensus disclaimer preserves an epistemic limit rather than evaluating the procedure.
